limitations: Each snapshot is cumulative; use only the latest snapshot or differences, never sum snapshots.
Different thread durations overlap; Wine and Vulkan totals are not removable frame cost.
Thread mappings are observed snapshots; exited or recycled handles may be missing or ambiguous.
Present CPU ticks cover only that thread, and invalid CPU intervals are excluded.
Only calls wholly inside the capture are counted; live snapshots may see partial updates.
No GPU timestamps, measured clocks or temperatures. No definitive CPU/GPU bottleneck verdict.
Different scenes, cache states and possibly clocks; no causal FPS gain can be computed.
Sub-30-FPS tail is a workload heuristic, not a verified scene boundary.
The new private GPU memory type confirms v13 memory policy, but the log has no ZCULL-active marker.
The baked runtime Mesa banner predates the v13 relink; the DXVK numeric driver version omits its suffix.
Per-thread waits and compilation durations overlap and must not be subtracted from frame time.
No GPU timestamp profile of rendering passes is available.
